Subject: Renewal procurement: onboarding refresh & portal validation

Hi Alex / procurement team,

Hope you’re well — our records show Brightline’s annual renewal (and the agreed capacity uplift) is coming up in August. Before Legal and Finance finalize the PO path, a few quick asks so we can keep the renewal on the faster lane: 

- We’ll send a short SOW amendment that captures the 20% capacity increase and the 12‑month term change. Please confirm the PO channel you prefer (standard Brightline PO vs. procurement portal).
- Brightline’s portal has a vendor verification step we haven’t walked through for this account — can you share the verification link or the team contact?
- We can provide SOC2 evidence and a pre-filled PO template to reduce back-and-forth.

Cc’ing Laura (finance) to keep the billing and PO template ready; Jordan from CS for any rollout notes. I’ll attach the draft SOW amendment once I have confirmation on the portal path.

Next step: if portal validation is simplest, share the link and the expected fields; I’ll populate and return today.

Best,
Jonas Weber

Subject: Re: Renewal procurement: onboarding refresh & portal validation

Jonas — thanks for the heads up. We’re aiming to close the renewal week of 8/7. A few notes: 

1) Portal path: please submit vendor data via our procurement portal: https://portal.brightlinehealth.com/vendor/onboard/verify/REDWOOD-8421. The portal requires: vendor tax ID, principal contact (name/email), and SOC2 summary.
2) PO: we typically issue a single PO for the committed amount once SOW is signed. We accept an emailed PO to procurement@brightlinehealth.com or the portal upload.
3) Term change: legal will want the SOW amendment redline and a short justification for the capacity uplift.

I’ll start the ticket on our side. If you can push the SOC2 summary and the amended SOW before EOD tomorrow, I’ll fast-track review.

— Alex
Alex Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager, Brightline Health
procurement@brightlinehealth.com

Jonas / team — reviewed the uploads. A couple of small asks from Legal/Finance: 

- Legal: replace the indemnity clause reference line to match our standard wording (I pasted the redline request into the portal ticket).
- Finance: can Redwood accept a staged PO? We prefer to issue an initial PO for 80% of the annual commitment today and the remaining 20% as a separate PO after capacity goes live. This helps our monthly ledger reconciliation.

If you can accept a staged PO (80/20) and submit a redlined SOW in the portal by EOD, we’ll kick finance to issue the first PO tomorrow.

— Alex

Alex — thanks for the ping. Confirming next steps and timelines: 

1) Redwood will accept the staged PO (80% initial / 20% post-activation). Laura has pre-filled PO_template-Brightline.xlsx with billing contact: finance-ops@redwood.ai and Net30 terms.
2) Marissa will post the indemnity clause redline to the portal ticket today (expected 7/21 EOD).
3) I attached a DocuSign room link if Brightline prefers signature-first: https://docusign.com/rooms/abc123-redwood-brightline.
4) Once we have either the PO (via portal upload or email to procurement@brightlinehealth.com) or a signed SOW, our operations team will schedule the capacity increase. Jordan will be the rollout lead and will follow up with a short cutover plan and estimated dates.

Please confirm if you want us to route the SOW to DocuSign now or wait for your finance team to issue the first PO. Either is fine — we’ll prioritize whichever gets Brightline on the books fastest.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
